user.title: Sure Finances Display
user.description:
Enter your Sure instance URL and API key.

• **URL**: e.g. `https://hostname/` (do not include `/api`)
• **API Key**: Generate a key in Sure under **Settings → API Keys**

data_description.url: Base URL of your Sure server, e.g. https://hostname/ (without /api)
data_description.api_key: API key generated in Sure under Settings → API Keys

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Sure server. Check the URL and network.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Verify your API key in Sure Settings.

abort.already_configured: This Sure server URL is already configured.
